comment: No family is set on any jack: nothing passes through them in Rack. As on the Hub, the direction is reversed from what a Rack user expects, because the names come from the hardware: Out9 to Out16 are Rack inputs and In7 to In12 are Rack outputs. Unlike a normal Rack expander this module is not found by adjacency; audio_expander.cc sets up no expander link at all, and the Hub scans the whole patch.
